verdict.failure_localized_to: transfer of the volunteer-fitted supralinear cytokine curve into the septic setting
verdict.consequence: drop cytokines as a reported endpoint; report attributable danger-signal exposure

simpson_tables.source: Simpson AJ, Opal SM, Angus BJ, Prins JM, Palardy JE, Parejo NA, Chaowagul W, White NJ. J Infect Dis 2000;181(3):1014-9

baseline_by_outcome.note: The printed TNF interquartile range for nonsurvivors reads '5.2-5.4', which cannot bracket a median of 14.4; recorded here as 5.2-54 on the assumption of a typesetting error. Nothing in this study depends on it.

simpson_tables.what_it_supports: Endotoxin ONLY. Ceftazidime produced ~5x the peak endotoxin of imipenem (P = .008), confirming the direction and giving the first in-patient estimate of the size of the agent effect.
simpson_tables.what_it_contradicts: The cytokine arm of the model. Despite ~5x the endotoxin, ceftazidime's median peak IL-6 was LOWER than imipenem's (291.9 vs 594.8; P = .36), and peak cytokines did not correlate with peak endotoxin in any of the three cytokines (IL-6 r = .23, P = .18). The cytokine comparison is noise-dominated -- the interquartile ranges span more than a decade -- but it certainly does not support the model's direction, and it must not be cited as if it did.

diagnosis.conclusion: error is in the DS->cytokine step, not release

tolerance_calibration.route: tolerance as a DOSE-RESPONSE RIGHT-SHIFT; induction rate held at the volunteer-safe value and the shift fitted
tolerance_calibration.output_scaling_failure: modelling tolerance as suppression of cytokine OUTPUT cannot satisfy both settings: it runs to k_tol_on ~4400/h and tolerance 0.999, breaking the volunteer calibration by 60-74%
tolerance_calibration.fitted_against: Simpson table 5 minus table 3, ceftazidime arm
